We've just onboarded Mytra (inventory robotics co) away from CAVT to help them scale their real-world data collection for perception models. They moved to our platform at a time where their data volume surged (as they were moving from simulation to real world testing and CVAT's frame-based limitation was slowing them down). 

We're helping them alongside other Physical AI co's (e.g. Skydio, Zipline, Fox Robotics) with a more effective system to index, auto-annotate and QA perception data across 2D (image & video) and 3D point cloud. With the goal of accelerating their model iteration cycles & increasing labelling throughput.

How are you thinking about perception training data at [COMPANY] Labs? I'm flexible afternoon times PT if you're up for a chat.
